title: Minor chord and arpeggio
summary: Connect a minor chord shape with separate ascending and descending notes.
goal: Connect a minor chord shape with an ascending and descending arpeggio.
body: First complete open strings, first frets and steady quarters. A minor chord contains root, minor third and fifth. The shown shape is calculated for the selected tuning. A changed shape may require a different hand position; no finger numbers are inferred from audio. The chord example is for display/listening only; simultaneous chords are not graded. For practice, damp the previous note before every new pluck. Start at 60 BPM or 40–50 for slower changes; try 70 after comfortable repeats.
